message: Thanks, Shel! If I can get consent from those represented, I'll post a picture here of me and the good folks who were here for the defense. It feels good. (And, yeah, OK: confession here: I put "Fly Me Courageous" on the radio this morning and got choked up. I think it's Mom-stuff, doing the formatting and knowing there's a dedication page, and knowing I have to do that before submitting it.)
